title: Codex Telegram Plan Mode Bridge
purpose: Define how Telegram carries SDK plan-mode configuration through to runtime clients without changing the existing Telegram plan-prompt workflow.
scope: This specification covers binding and propagation of SDK plan-mode options, the separation between SDK plan mode and the Telegram plan prompt wrapper, and the expectation that goal mode remains thread-goal state rather than a sibling mode surface.
context: The repository already has a Telegram /plan prompt path implemented by CodexPlanModePrompt and CodexSessionManager, and it already clones CodexClientOptions per runtime slot in CodexSessionRuntimeRegistry. The .NET SDK now exposes a nested CodexClientOptions.PlanMode configuration object. This specification makes the Telegram bridge explicit without redefining the Telegram planning workflow itself.

requirements.title: Preserve the existing Telegram plan prompt workflow
requirements.statement: Telegram MUST preserve the existing prompt-driven Plan mode workflow, including CodexPlanModePrompt and the /plan command behavior, and MUST NOT replace it with a separate SDK plan-mode command surface or a separate plan-mode client.

requirements.title: Propagate SDK plan-mode options through configuration and runtime cloning
requirements.statement: Telegram MUST bind and propagate the SDK CodexClientOptions.PlanMode object through process configuration and runtime-client cloning so every runtime slot sees the same configured plan-mode defaults.
notes: The current repo fallback pin is Incursa.OpenAI.Codex 2.2.0, so the package surface now exposes the SDK plan-mode configuration object described by this requirement.

requirements.title: Keep goal mode separate from plan mode
requirements.statement: Telegram MUST keep goal mode separate from plan-mode configuration and MUST continue to expose goal behavior through the existing thread-goal APIs and /goal controls rather than creating a goal-mode option tree parallel to Plan mode.
